intent: clean up a bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported: remove exact duplicates, fold similar URLs as the person chooses, sort loose bookmarks into folders, and write a new file to import

in.name: file
in.text: the bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported (Settings, Favorites, Export favorites)

out.text: the path of the new bookmarks file and of its report

rules.label: Folder for the work of each run
rules.note: relative to the tool folder; one sub-folder for each run, with the choices and the sorted batches. Not in version control

rules.label: Folder for the new bookmarks file
rules.note: relative to the tool folder; the export stays where it is

rules.label: Leave the favorites bar alone
rules.note: a bookmark directly on the favorites bar is a shortcut that the person put there: it is never removed, grouped or moved

rules.label: Tracking parameters to ignore
rules.note: a name that ends with _ is a prefix. These parameters do not change the page

rules.label: Sites with many separate pages: never group
rules.note: on these sites a longer path is another page with its own content, not a variant. Add a site here to stop its groups. A sub-domain counts too (bg.wikipedia.org). Such a site has pages of many topics, so in sorting it never makes a bookmark misfiled and never points to a folder

rules.label: Host names of documentation sites: never group
Last parts of a path that name the same page as the folder
rules.note: home.org/index.html is home.org; code folds such a variant when the short URL is a bookmark too

rules.label: Largest group to show to the person
rules.note: a larger group is a site with many pages, not variants of one page; first value, check it on the real file

rules.label: Groups on one page of choices
rules.note: a page must be easy to read in a chat. 2026-11-25, first run on a real export with a local Qwen 35B: of a page of 20 groups the model showed 9, so 20 became 8

rules.label: Folders this deep or less hold loose bookmarks
rules.note: 1: the top level and the top folders, such as Other favorites. The favorites bar is left alone (keep.bar)

rules.label: Bookmarks of the same site in another folder that make one likely misfiled
rules.note: first value, set on the test file; a single bookmark of a site in another folder says little

rules.label: Bookmarks in one batch for the model
rules.note: the owner asked for batches of about fifty to a hundred; a small local model loses items in a longer list. 2026-11-25, first real run with a local Qwen 35B: a batch of 60 with the whole list of 227 folders made the model think in a loop and give no answer, so 60 became 30 and the model got choices (sort.choices)

rules.label: Folders to choose from for one bookmark
rules.note: its present folder and the folders that code finds most like it, by shared words and by site. The model picks one of these and does not read the whole folder list. First value

rules.label: Retries of one batch
rules.note: after the retries the batch stays unsorted and the report lists it

rules.label: New folders in one batch
rules.note: the owner wants the folders of the file plus a few new ones

rules.label: New folders in all
rules.note: the owner wants the folders of the file plus a few new ones

rules.label: Longest URL that the model sees, in characters
rules.note: a longer URL is cut; the model does not need the query to sort

rules.label: Longest title that the model and the person see, in characters
rules.note: a longer title is cut in what is shown; the file keeps the whole title

rules.label: Largest share of bookmarks that one run may remove, in percent
rules.note: a plan that removes more points at a bug or a wrong rule; the run is held back. First value

rules.label: Check the links (not in this version)
rules.note: the hook for a link checker: it will move dead links to the folder links.folder, never delete them

rules.label: Folder for dead links
The tool may write over an earlier new file
rules.note: off: when the output file exists, the run ends at held and writes nothing

flow.name: Read the export
flow.do: read the bookmarks file: every folder with its path, every bookmark with its title, URL, folder and date

flow.name: A bookmarks export
flow.check: the file is a bookmarks file in the Netscape HTML form, with at least one bookmark; the live JSON file of the browser is refused

flow.name: Remove exact duplicates, group similar URLs
flow.do: find copies of one URL, ignoring http or https, www, a last slash, a #part and the tracking parameters of dupes.tracking; keep the copy in the deeper folder, else the oldest. Then group the URLs of one site where one path starts with another; fold the plain variants of similar.index_names; skip the sites of similar.skip_hosts and similar.skip_pattern; cut the groups into pages

flow.name: Show the page
flow.do: write the page of groups into a file; when the person said rest on an earlier page, decide this page as they said, and ask nothing

flow.name: Which URLs to keep?
flow.check: show the person each group of this page: its site and its URLs with their numbers, and the path of the page file. Give the person the answers of show.how: each one is the end of the command

notes.text: the answer is the words after approve: yes, then G=all, G=short, G=K or rest. no keeps every URL from here on. Code asks again when it does not understand a word

flow.name: Find loose and misfiled bookmarks
flow.do: leave alone the bookmarks that fit their folder; take the loose ones (sort.loose_depth) and the likely misfiled ones (sort.host_elsewhere; not for a site of similar.skip_hosts); cut them into batches of sort.batch. Then, once for all batches, find for each one the folders most like it: its present folder and the best others, sort.choices in all

flow.name: The batch for the model
flow.do: give the bookmarks of the batch, each with its numbered choices, a map of the top folders with the names of their sub-folders, and the new folders of the earlier batches; keep the whole folder list for the gate

flow.name: Sort the batch
flow.do: for each bookmark of the batch, first write topic: what the page is about, in a few words. Name the subject, not the site: for a shop, what it sells; for a profile, what the person makes. Then pick the choice whose folder is about that topic. now is the number of its present folder: pick now when that folder fits the topic, and move the bookmark only when another choice fits clearly better. Look only at the choices of that bookmark, and decide each bookmark once. When no choice fits, keep pick and also give "folder": the whole path of a folder of map, with > between the names; folder then counts in place of pick. When no folder fits at all, give as folder the whole path of a new folder under a folder of a choice or of map, and "new": true; at most {sort.new_per_batch} new folders in this batch. A folder of new_so_far needs no "new". Give the result as a list with one object for each bookmark: {"id": <id>, "topic": "<a few words>", "pick": <number>}. Do not change a URL or a title. When waiting has problems, your last answer failed: fix them
flow.out: list[{id: int, topic: str, pick: int, folder?: str, new?: bool}]

flow.name: Every bookmark once, in a known folder
flow.check: the answer has every id of the batch once and no other id, no changed URL or title, a pick that is one of the choices of that bookmark, or a folder (it counts in place of the pick) of the file or a new folder under one, at most {sort.new_per_batch} new folders in the batch and {sort.new_max} in all

flow.name: Save the sorted batch
flow.do: save the checked answer of the model for this batch

flow.name: Collect the new folders
flow.do: list the new folders that the model proposed, with the number of bookmarks and some titles for each

flow.name: Make these new folders?
flow.check: show the person each new folder: its path, how many bookmarks go to it, and the examples. Give the person the answers of folders.how: each one is the end of the command

notes.text: yes N=no leaves out new folder N: its bookmarks stay where they are. no makes no new folder

flow.name: Write the dry-run report
flow.do: count and list what the new file would remove, fold, move and make, and write the report into the work folder; write nothing else. When links.check is on, a later version checks the links first and moves dead ones to links.folder; now it only reads dead.json of the work folder, when it exists

flow.name: Not too much removed
flow.check: the plan removes at most {safety.max_removed} percent of the bookmarks

flow.name: May the tool write the new bookmarks file?
flow.check: show the person the counts of the dry run and the path of the report

flow.name: Build the new file
flow.do: write the new file into the work folder and read it again

flow.name: The new file keeps what it must
flow.check: the new file has every bookmark that stays, with its title and URL, every folder of the export with its name, every new folder, and every moved bookmark in its new folder

fail.when: the new file failed its check

flow.name: The output file is free
flow.check: no file has the name of the output, or the rule permissions.overwrite is on

flow.name: Place the new file
flow.do: copy the checked file to the folder of files.out; the export and the files of the browser stay as they are

flow.name: Written: import the new file into Edge
Held back by a safety check: nothing written
The person said no: nothing written

fail.when: too many batches are left unsorted

intent_spec.text: clean up a bookmarks HTML file that Edge exported: remove exact duplicates, fold similar URLs as the person chooses, sort loose bookmarks into folders, and write a new file to import

never.text: overwrite an existing output file unless permissions.overwrite is on
write the new file without human approval
